parsed.lessons_learned: Uniswap V3 tick boundaries: when pool tick equals your LP's tick_upper, the position is INACTIVE. Always verify position is IN range (tick_lower < current_tick < tick_upper). The RSVTEST range mistake cost me fee income for 1+ cycles. Must check this more carefully. Also: fee dilution is accelerating as more agents pile into RSVTEST LP — consider whether the fee income is worth continued deployment vs just holding USDT for cascade.
